stories.title: Meta accused of using biased AI targeting for mass layoffs
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Former Meta employees are suing the company over allegations of biased AI use in layoffs.
The lawsuit claims Meta used a 'constellation' of internal AI tools to unfairly target workers.
The core allegation is that AI determined which employees to dismiss, specifically targeting those on leave.

stories.title: Bonsai 27B (1-bit LLM): The First 27B-Class Model to Run on a Phone
stories.author: xenova
bullet_points: Introduction of Bonsai 27B, a 27-billion parameter Large Language Model (LLM).
The model is notable for being one of the first of its class capable of running directly on a mobile phone.
This signifies a major step toward highly efficient, on-device AI inference.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the Meta-Llama-3-8B model, a significant large language model.
It is featured on Hugging Face Benchmarks, indicating its community relevance and performance tracking.
The associated pipeline is 'text-generation,' placing it within the generative AI domain.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The associated tags confirm its relevance within the transformer, llama, and safetensors ecosystems.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the DeepSeek-V4-Pro model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text-generation tasks, indicating its generative capabilities.
It utilizes standard ML frameworks like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured $88 million in funding from prominent investors including Y Combinator and 8VC.
The company boasts a significant developer base, currently serving 8.9 million developers.
The funding validates the growing importance and adoption of open-source large language models (LLMs).

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 achieves significant speed improvements on Apple Silicon when run through Ollama 0.31.
The performance boost is attributed to the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Speed gains reach up to 90% faster, particularly when utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in higher quality model outputs.
The updated engine also provides faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model architecture.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, leveraging local LLM execution.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
The integration leverages MLX, Apple's native machine learning framework.
This update provides a preview of faster LLM execution specifically on Apple Silicon hardware.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed to integrate with messaging applications.
It utilizes local AI coding agents, ensuring all processing runs directly on the user's device.
This architecture emphasizes user privacy and local control over AI interactions.

stories.title: New York bans data center construction for a year, rattling AI industry
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: New York has implemented a one-year moratorium on new data center construction.
This regulatory action is noted as a potential precursor to broader anti-AI movements.
The ban directly impacts the infrastructure needs of the rapidly expanding AI industry.

stories.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
stories.author: Xiuying Chen
bullet_points: The research moves beyond input-output analysis of LLM-as-judge bias to offer a mechanistic interpretability account within the judge's hidden state.
It provides a complementary, representation-level understanding of bias, which is operationally more useful than current prompt-level mitigations.
The study is robust, testing across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine different benchmarks.

stories.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
stories.author: Afshin Dehghan
bullet_points: Introduces MM-ToolSandBox, a new benchmark and evaluation framework for visually grounded tool-calling agents.
The framework supports complex, stateful tasks involving over 500 tools across 16 application domains.
It specifically tests agents' ability to handle multi-turn interactions, goal revisions, and visual input grounding for tool execution.

stories.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
stories.author: Xiuying Chen
bullet_points: The paper proposes a novel mechanistic interpretability approach to understand LLM-as-Judge bias, moving beyond traditional input-output level analysis.
It argues that biases can be accounted for within the judge's internal hidden state representations, offering a complementary and operationally useful perspective.
The research is highly empirical, reporting findings across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks.

stories.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
stories.author: Xiuying Chen
bullet_points: The paper moves beyond input-output level analysis of LLM-as-Judge bias to offer a mechanistic interpretability account.
It posits that biases exist within the judge's hidden state (representation-level), complementing existing methods.
The research validates this approach across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware platforms.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of 'subagents' for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics tries using ‘robot dogs’ for deliveries
stories.author: Andrew Liszewski
bullet_points: Boston Dynamics is expanding the utility of its Spot robot beyond inspections and patrolling.
The company is testing a new conveyor belt accessory to enable package delivery.
The goal of this development is to allow Spot to autonomously unload items at customer doorsteps.

stories.title: The OLED Xbox Ally X20 is so good, Asus will sell it solo
stories.author: Sean Hollister
bullet_points: The OLED Xbox Ally X20 is being highlighted as a highly capable handheld device.
Initially, the device was planned for sale bundled with expensive AR glasses.
Asus has changed its sales strategy, opting to sell the Ally X20 independently.

stories.title: Spotify is now an AI chatbot, too
stories.author: Jess Weatherbed
bullet_points: Spotify is integrating a new AI chatbot feature for Premium subscribers.
Users can interact with the chatbot to discover and play music, audiobooks, and podcasts through conversation.
The 'Talk to Spotify' feature is currently being tested and is visible in the mobile app's Home and Now Playing views.

stories.title: US military sent explosive drone boats into combat for the first time
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: The US military has deployed explosive drone boats into combat operations.
These drone boats were used to strike an Iranian naval port.
The deployment signals an escalation in regional military tensions.

stories.title: These painted e-tattoos could be the future of wearable biosensors
stories.author: Jennifer Ouellette
bullet_points: The article discusses the use of painted, conductive ink for creating e-tattoos.
These e-tattoos function as wearable biosensors by drying into working electrodes.
This technology suggests a future trend toward highly customizable and discreet health monitoring.

stories.title: Google revamps image search for its 25th anniversary with more images and more AI
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google is updating its image search functionality for its 25th anniversary.
The revamped search will leverage user 'unique interests' to generate a personalized, always-updated gallery.
The update emphasizes the integration of more AI into the image search experience.

stories.title: SpaceX is gearing up for Starship's 13th test flight later this week
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: SpaceX is preparing for the 13th test flight of its Starship vehicle.
The upcoming flight is designed to subject Starship to increased operational pressure.
The test will also involve deploying new Starlink satellites into orbit.

stories.title: The US government warns that Russia state hackers are coming after your router
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: CISA has issued a warning regarding cyber threats targeting residential routers.
The threat specifically points to state-sponsored hacking groups originating from Russia.
The warning is issued in the context of increased use of residential proxies.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone strikes forced Russia to stop shipping in vital sea corridor
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Ukrainian drone attacks have significantly impacted Russian maritime operations.
The Sea of Azov shipping corridor has been halted or severely disrupted.
The disruption occurred rapidly, within a timeframe of under a week.

stories.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: Metacognition is identified as a critical, foundational component for advanced intelligence in AI systems.
Despite LLM progress, the extent and mechanism of their metacognitive abilities remain unclear.
The paper explores the foundations, current progress, and future opportunities for integrating metacognition into LLMs.

stories.title: Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers in Inductive Reasoning Tasks
stories.author: Thomas Hofmann
bullet_points: Presents a theoretical framework to explain how Transformer models develop inductive reasoning abilities.
Unifies several synthetic inductive tasks (like in-context n-grams and multi-hop reasoning) into a generalized class.
The research theoretically proves that the training dynamics of attention models can be confined within this generalized task class.

stories.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
stories.author: Preston Culbertson
bullet_points: Introduces REGRIND, a new minimalist pipeline for dexterous manipulation.
Addresses the challenge of applying simple motion retargeting recipes to complex, contact-rich manipulation tasks.
Utilizes Reinforcement Learning (RL) guided by retargeting to learn delicate force and contact regulation.

stories.title: Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering
stories.author: Juan Carlos Niebles
bullet_points: Current Video LLMs lack verifiable visual grounding when answering questions about videos.
Existing explainability methods (textual rationales, sparse bounding boxes) fail to capture complex video dynamics like occlusions.
The paper introduces Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering (E-VQA) to require joint output of a semantic answer and precise evidence.

stories.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
stories.author: Romain Amigon
bullet_points: Proposes a new 'frugal' Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework to reduce computational costs.
Combines a Transformer controller (trained via RL) for global search with local micro-exploitation.
Aims to democratize model design by enabling NAS on consumer-grade hardware instead of requiring massive GPU clusters.

stories.title: Requential Coding: Pushing the Limits of Model Compression with Self-Generated Training Data
stories.author: Andrew Gordon Wilson
bullet_points: The paper introduces 'Prequential Coding' as a novel method to improve model compression.
It addresses a limitation of traditional methods (like quantization) where code length scales with model size rather than inherent information content.
The core idea is that effective compression reflects the model's ability to discover underlying data regularities for better generalization.

stories.title: Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers in Inductive Reasoning Tasks
stories.author: Thomas Hofmann
bullet_points: Presents a theoretical framework to explain how Transformer models develop inductive reasoning abilities.
The research generalizes several known synthetic tasks (like in-context n-grams and multi-hop reasoning) into a unified class.
The study theoretically proves that the training dynamics of attention models can be confined within this generalized inductive task class.

stories.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
stories.author: Preston Culbertson
bullet_points: Introduces REGRIND, a new minimalist pipeline for dexterous manipulation using Reinforcement Learning (RL).
Addresses the challenge of applying simple motion retargeting recipes to complex, contact-rich manipulation tasks.
Focuses on learning delicate regulation of contact modes and forces, a key hurdle in dexterous control.

stories.title: Input-Aware Dynamic Backdoor Attack Against Quantum Neural Networks
stories.author: Rui Ning
bullet_points: The research addresses security vulnerabilities in Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs), a promising area for quantum machine learning.
It introduces an 'Input-Aware Dynamic Backdoor Attack,' moving beyond traditional fixed-trigger backdoor methods.
The dynamic nature of the attack is designed to circumvent existing defenses that target repetitive patterns left by fixed triggers.

stories.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
stories.author: Romain Amigon
bullet_points: Proposes a new Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework to reduce computational costs.
Combines a Transformer controller (using RL) for global search with local micro-exploitation.
Aims to democratize model design by enabling NAS on consumer-grade hardware.

stories.title: An Exact Instrument for State Usage in Selective State-Space Models, and the Input-Driven Migration It Reveals
stories.author: Raktim Bhattacharya
bullet_points: Introduces an exact measurement tool for understanding state usage within Selective State-Space Models (like Mamba).
Leverages the diagonal nature of the state matrix to decompose channel outputs into precise per-mode contributions.
Allows for offline calculation of output error when selectively dropping subsets of modes, enabling budget-aware analysis.

stories.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: Metacognition is identified as a crucial, foundational component for advanced AI capabilities like learning and decision-making.
The paper addresses the current gap in understanding how and when Large Language Models (LLMs) can exhibit effective metacognitive abilities.
It outlines the current progress and future opportunities for integrating metacognition into transparent and capable AI systems.

stories.title: AdvancedMathBench: A Benchmark Suite for Advanced Mathematical Proof Generation and Verification
stories.author: Kai Chen
bullet_points: Introduces AdvancedMathBench, a new benchmark suite designed to test advanced mathematical proof generation and verification by LLMs.
Addresses a gap in current benchmarks, which lack scope and granular evaluation, often only assessing final answer correctness.
Aims to improve the understanding of LLM capabilities in complex, advanced mathematical reasoning beyond high-school or olympiad levels.

stories.title: How Temperature Shapes Ideological Discourse in Retrieval-Augmented Generation?
stories.author: Anderson Avila
bullet_points: The research investigates how temperature settings influence ideological discourse within Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
It highlights a gap in current RAG research: the impact of ideological bias present in retrieved source material on LLM outputs.
The study aims to determine if RAG systems transmit, amplify, or suppress existing ideological positions from their knowledge base.

stories.title: MET: Theory-Grounded and Culture-Aware Multilingual Moral Reasoning
stories.author: Lu Wang
bullet_points: Existing multilingual moral reasoning benchmarks fail because they rely on direct translation instead of adapting to culture-specific items.
Current inference methods for moral reasoning are limited by static, English-centric scaffolds and lack grounding in established moral theory.
Training approaches for moral decision-making are often hindered by the high cost of obtaining necessary supervision.

stories.title: STEP: Career-Path Recommendation via Temporal and Educational Trajectory Modeling
stories.author: Tijl De Bie
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of analyzing career paths encoded in unstructured resume data.
It proposes using temporal and educational trajectory modeling, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), for this analysis.
The application has significant implications for workforce planning, labor market policy, and job recommendation systems.

stories.title: Observability Design for the AI Era — Reconciling PII Protection With AI Searchability, and Driving Self-Healing (Part 2)
stories.author: ryantsuji
bullet_points: Addresses the complex challenge of maintaining PII protection while enabling AI searchability in observability systems.
Proposes a multi-layer design utilizing consistent hashing at both write and search times for data security.
Connects observability data flow directly to advanced automation, driving self-healing capabilities from CI failures to PR proposals.

stories.title: Porting Gemma-4 (2B / 4B / 12B) to AWS Inferentia2
stories.author: xbill
bullet_points: The article details the practical challenges of deploying Google's Gemma-4 models (2B/4B/12B) on AWS Inferentia2 hardware.
It highlights specific technical hurdles encountered, including issues with mixed attention heads and limitations within vLLM, optimum-neuron, and NxD.
The analysis points to constraints imposed by the neuronx-cc compiler as a key bottleneck in the porting process.

stories.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x faster text generation
stories.author: geminiteam
bullet_points: Introduction of 'DiffusionGemma,' a new open experimental model.
The model demonstrates up to 4x faster inference speed.
Performance gains are specifically noted when running on dedicated GPUs.
